title: Hurricane Helene power outage observations and I-40 road closure milestones
study_geographies: I-40 Pigeon River Gorge, North Carolina and Tennessee

eaglei_haywood_county.name: Haywood County, North Carolina

The Environment for Analysis of Geo-Located Energy Information’s Recorded Electricity Outages 2014-2025. figshare. Dataset. https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.24237376.v4
eaglei_haywood_county.changes_from_source: Filtered to FIPS 37087 and Sep 25–Oct 15 local dates. Placed recorded values on a complete 15-minute time axis retaining missing slots as null and kept UTC times. Calculated the highest observed count and compared exact matches to selected state timestamps.

road_milestones_local_dates.text: NCDOT dates the storm damage to September 27 and says it immediately closed the interstate. Exact switch time is not given.

methods_and_limits: Use the timestamp in each DOE outage table and retain report publication time separately. The state table values are agency-reported customer counts. Source percentages are transcribed as displayed and were not used in the comparisons.

Filter the original 2024 EAGLE-I CSV to FIPS 37087. Parse run_start_time as UTC and display Eastern Daylight Time for the study window. Exact same-minute matching is used for the parallel county and state entries.

Keep missing 15-minute readings as null and preserve separately reported zeros. EAGLE-I collects utility public map counts, which can include outage causes other than Helene. No site-level start, end, frequency or restoration estimate is calculated.

Store the I-40 closure and reopenings independently with their road segment and restrictions. The calendar-day figure counts between reported dates. It is neither a customer outage duration nor an estimate of conditions during each missing observation.
